description:
── Stop guessing what your AI tools are actually costing you. ──

If you're juggling subscriptions to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Midjourney, Perplexity and ElevenLabs, the bills add up fast — and most people have no idea where their money is actually going. This AI Ops Dashboard is a single HTML file that opens in any browser and gives you a beautiful, real-time view of every AI platform you use, what you've spent, and where you're headed by the end of the month.

No logins. No cloud. No subscriptions. Just double-click and go.

─────────────────────────────
✦ WHAT IT DOES
─────────────────────────────

▸ Platform Cards — Dedicated cards for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, Midjourney & ElevenLabs, each with a recognisable logo icon. Add or remove platforms any time.

▸ Animated Usage Bars — Each platform shows a live progress bar (left to right) of your current usage vs. your monthly budget. Hits 80%? The bar turns red and the card glows — you'll know before you overspend.

▸ Subscription & API Mode — Toggle between manual subscription tracking and per-token API cost calculation depending on how you pay.

▸ Total Monthly Spend Card — One big, clear number across all platforms at a glance.

▸ 6-Month Spend History Chart — Built with the native Canvas API, no third-party libraries needed. See your spending trends over the last six months in a clean bar chart.

▸ Projected End-of-Month Spend — Smart calculation based on your current pace and days remaining in the month, so you can course-correct before the bill hits.

▸ Full Add / Edit / Delete — Customise every platform, set your own budgets, and manage your stack exactly how you work.

▸ Your Brand, Your Dashboard — Drop in your own 40×40 logo and set a custom title in seconds. Perfect for agencies and freelancers presenting to clients.

▸ Persistent Data — Everything saves to localStorage automatically. Refresh the page, close the tab, come back tomorrow — your data is always there.

─────────────────────────────
✦ WHAT'S INCLUDED
─────────────────────────────

Basic — Dark Techy theme (1 HTML file)
The signature dark UI with cyan + violet accents, JetBrains Mono headings, and that satisfying terminal-meets-analytics look. Built for developers and power users who live in dark mode.

Standard — All 3 Themes (3 HTML files)
▸ Dark Techy — Dark background, glowing accents, monospace headings
▸ Clean Minimal — White/light grey base, soft typography, professional and distraction-free
▸ Earthy Pastel — Warm neutrals and muted tones, calm and approachable

Premium — All 3 Themes + Custom Colour Builder (4 HTML files)
Everything in Standard, plus a built-in custom colour picker so you can dial in your exact brand colours — background, cards, accent, text — without touching a single line of code.

─────────────────────────────
✦ HOW TO USE
─────────────────────────────

1. Download your file(s) immediately after purchase
2. Double-click the HTML file — it opens in Chrome, Firefox, Edge or Safari
3. Add your AI platforms and monthly budgets
4. Toggle between Subscription or API Token mode
5. Watch your spend dashboard come to life

No installs. No accounts. No internet connection required after download.

─────────────────────────────
✦ PERFECT FOR
─────────────────────────────

→ Freelancers and solopreneurs tracking AI tool costs
→ Agencies managing AI budgets across multiple client projects
→ Developers monitoring API token spend across platforms
→ AI enthusiasts who want a clean, private dashboard without paying for SaaS tools
→ Small teams keeping AI costs visible and accountable

─────────────────────────────
✦ TECHNICAL DETAILS
─────────────────────────────

• File type: Single self-contained HTML file (HTML + CSS + JS in one)
• Requirements: Any modern browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari)
• Data storage: localStorage — 100% local, 100% private, zero data shared
• No frameworks, no CDN dependencies, no internet required after download
• Fonts load from Google Fonts on first open (optional — works offline too)
• Fully editable source code — tweak anything you like

─────────────────────────────
✦ INSTANT DOWNLOAD
─────────────────────────────

Your file(s) will be available to download immediately after payment is confirmed. Check your Etsy Purchases page or your confirmation email.

⚠ This is a digital product — no physical item will be shipped. Due to the instant-access nature of digital downloads, all sales are final. Please message me before purchasing if you have any questions — I'm happy to help!

─────────────────────────────
✦ LICENCE
─────────────────────────────

For personal and commercial use (your own business or client projects). Redistribution or resale of the template files is not permitted.

Have a question? Message the shop — replies usually within a few hours. ✌
